title: Hasbro Transformers Age of the Primes Nexus Prime Voyager Action Figure, 6.25 in
bullets: Switch up your display by converting Nexus Prime between robot and jet tank in 23 steps.
Plan your display space around the 6.25-inch figure height.
Bring more of the Transformers universe to your shelf with character-inspired sculpting and decoration.
Change the figure’s setup with the included blasters.
Add a story-specific detail to your display with the included Enigma of Combination artifact.
description: The Thirteen Nexus Prime joins Hasbro’s Transformers Age of the Primes line as a Voyager Class action figure. The figure stands 6.25 inches tall and can change from robot mode to a jet tank in 23 steps. Its sculpt and decoration are inspired by the character in the Transformers universe. The package contains one Nexus Prime figure, blasters and the Enigma of Combination artifact accessory. Use the robot mode to display the character with the included accessories, or convert it to the jet tank to display the alternate configuration.
meta_description: Shop Hasbro’s 6.25-inch Nexus Prime Voyager figure with 23-step conversion, blasters and Enigma of Combination accessory at Elvarins.
